I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to bring to your attention several discrepancies I have noticed in my recent travel expense records. I have attached copies of the receipts and screenshots of the recorded amounts for your reference. Please let me know if you require any additional information or documentation from my side.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response and a swift resolution.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]
